description: Change of use from doctors surgery to children's day nursery (Use class E); Retention of a single storey rear conservatory extension; conversion of garage into a playroom with installation of doors and window and alterations to raise height of front boundary treatment; installation of boundary fence and access gates fronting the highway.
decision_conditions:
The use hereby permitted shall not be open to nursery customers outside the following times:-
(a) 0800 hours to 18.00 hours, Monday to Friday without the prior written permission of the local planning authority.
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise depicted on the approved drawings.

<p>Prior to the first operational use of the development the following details shall be submitted to the council and approved in writing by the local planning authority</p><p>- A parking plan scheme including swept analysis confirming the total number of on site parking spaces,</p><p>- Location of refuse storage on site and their collection strategy</p><p>- Proposed area of external playspace for future children's use on site. </p><p>These details shall include an implementation programme.&nbsp;</p><p><br></p><p><br></p><p><br></p>

<p>The nursery/crèche use hereby permitted shall accommodate no more than 29 children at any one time, excluding staff members. This maximum occupancy shall be maintained throughout the operation of the premises unless otherwise agreed through a further grant of planning permission by the Local Planning Authority.</p>
